meta.target: theoutlines/stize: app/lib (Flutter), web landing, store screenshots

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the map chrome, lists and settings.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and rows on bg: arrival rows, favourite stops, idea cards.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The bottom sheet over the map (Nearby, stop board, line) and the desktop rail.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers above a card; in light it is separated by shadow-float, not by tone.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Tile behind an icon, empty-state picture frame.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, values, the big ETA, primary icons. Was `white` in The Outlines: same role, theme-aware.

tokens.name: ink-85
tokens.usage: Body copy when ink is too loud: long explanations, privacy text.

tokens.name: ink-80
tokens.usage: Label of the tertiary button (on fill-06).

tokens.name: ink-75
tokens.usage: Control labels, unselected segments, chip labels.

tokens.name: ink-60
tokens.usage: Secondary text: destination under a line, stop distance, row labels, chevrons.

tokens.name: ink-50
tokens.usage: Floor: notes, Updated N s ago, footers, placeholders. Dark 5.3:1 on bg; light 4.6:1 on bg (alpha raised to 0.6 so it holds).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink-filled control: the primary (white/black) button, a picked chip.

tokens.name: fill-05
tokens.usage: Rest fill of every 44px control: search field, segmented track.

tokens.name: fill-06
tokens.usage: Tertiary button.

tokens.name: fill-07
tokens.usage: Chips (line filter, vehicle type).

tokens.name: fill-08
tokens.usage: Icon buttons (40px), map controls on the sheet.

tokens.name: fill-10
tokens.usage: Pressed or editing state of a field.

tokens.name: fill-14
tokens.usage: Sliding pill of a segmented control.

tokens.name: fill-16
tokens.usage: Strong fill: picked tile, slider fill.

tokens.name: fill-24
tokens.usage: Progress, scrollbars.

tokens.name: fill-32
tokens.usage: Sheet grabber, ticks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal; never behind the map sheet (the map stays usable).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent (owner's pick 2026-11-22: A, signal green), meaning “look here”: the brand mark, the landing CTA, a live indicator on neutral ground, a likely mistake in a field. Never on transit colour (arrival cards), body text, focus rings or large areas. Dark 9.4:1 on bg; light 4.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (button label 16px medium or larger).

tokens.name: accent-14
tokens.usage: Ground of an accent note or a live badge.

tokens.name: late
tokens.usage: Analytics signal "problem here" (city section): the worst line, often-late hours. Only on charts, never on transit colour or body text.

tokens.name: transit-bus
tokens.usage: Data layer, not UI accent. Bus: line badge, stop pin, vehicle coin, route line. Aligned 2026-11-23 with tram and trolleybus (same chroma, closer lightness; real Belgrade colours kept). Label on it: on-transit (white, 4.3:1).

tokens.name: transit-trolleybus
tokens.usage: Data layer. Trolleybus. Aligned 2026-11-23: clean orange without the yellow cast; the white line number is 3.1:1 (large text). Change map_support.dart and moving_object_layer.dart to match.

tokens.name: transit-tram
tokens.usage: Data layer. Tram (Belgrade livery red), aligned 2026-11-23 (no brick cast). Label on it: on-transit (white, 4.4:1).

tokens.name: transit-tram-rail
tokens.usage: Tram rails on the map.

tokens.name: transit-mixed
tokens.usage: Data layer. Stop served by bus + trolleybus (tram always wins).

tokens.name: transit-stuck
tokens.usage: Data layer. A vehicle that looks stuck; deep crimson, distinct from tram red by lightness.

tokens.name: on-transit
tokens.usage: Line number on bus, tram, mixed and stuck badges.

tokens.name: on-transit-trolleybus
tokens.usage: Line number on the trolleybus badge: white like every other badge (owner, 2026-11-22). 3.1:1, so the number is semibold (line-number style) in lists and medium 16 in chips; never smaller text on orange.

tokens.name: favorite
tokens.usage: Favourite star on the map and in rows.

tokens.name: eta-earlier
tokens.usage: ETA delta: arrives earlier than before. Same value as accent.

tokens.name: eta-later
tokens.usage: ETA delta: arrives later. Neutral ink with an up arrow, not a colour: later is information, not an error (open question for the owner).

tokens.name: scheduled
tokens.usage: Scheduled (not live) arrival text; paired with the word Scheduled, never colour alone.

tokens.name: place
tokens.usage: Searched place pin.

styles.name: eta-hero
styles.usage: The big next-arrival ETA on a stop board (“3 min”). Tabular figures.

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: ETA in an arrival row, counts on cards. Tabular figures.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Screen titles: stop name on the stop board, Settings.

styles.name: date
styles.usage: Departure time in a schedule row (24h).

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section titles in sheets (“Nearby”), line number + destination headers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, answers, field input (never below 16 in a field or iOS zooms).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Row titles: destination, stop name in lists.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Lines under titles in ink-60: stop + distance.

styles.name: line-number
styles.usage: Line number inside a LineBadge in vertical lists (arrival rows, Nearby, My stops). The one semibold in the system (owner, 2026-11-22). Chips and map coins stay medium.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Only chart axis ticks (analytics) and slider ends. Never ETAs, line numbers or labels.

type.rule: Sizes 10, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 44 (and the landing hero 104). Never 13, 14 or 15. Weights 400 and 500, plus 600 only for line-number. Line heights in px, multiples of 4. Uncut Sans covers Latin incl. Serbian č ć ž š đ; it has no Cyrillic, so the app ships EN and SR (Latin) only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a label pair (title + subtitle).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on mobile; card padding; gap between blocks on a screen.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Text inset inside the hero and the verdict card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between questions in the wizard; between landing sub-blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above the footer; between landing sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap before the next question on a screen that holds two (a count, then which plans).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of wizard pages on desktop.

spacing.rule: Every size is a multiple of 4: spacing, heights and widths, radii, icon sizes, type sizes and line heights. Lines and strokes are 1, 2 or 4 px, never 3: 1 for hairlines; 2 for icon strokes, chevrons, focus rings and dashed limits; 4 for slider handles and the share-bar divider. Exceptions: the 2px gap between segments, full-round shapes (radius = half the height).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The pill inside a segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checks, the editable number box.

tokens.name: radius-control
